title: QZX Result Contract v1
description: Open result envelope for QZX commands and compatible agent-facing command tools. Producers may add command-specific fields without changing the stable core.

success.description: True only when the requested operation completed successfully.

message.description: A complete human-readable summary of the outcome.

error.description: A human-readable failure description when success is false.

error_code.description: A stable machine-oriented failure identifier when available.

details.description: Structured diagnostic, remediation, or domain-specific details.

warnings.description: Non-fatal conditions that deserve explicit attention.

schema_version.description: Version of the shared QZX result metadata envelope.

meta.description: Shared invocation metadata. Command-specific metadata may use additional fields.
